caveats: CEILING EFFECT, severe: four of five criteria sit at their extremes (V1 1.0, V2 1.0 with max_consecutive_redundant_actions == 0 in all 20 trials, V4 20/20). Criteria passing AT a ceiling carry no information about where the threshold actually bites. V3b is the only criterion whose margin is informative.

FLOOR EFFECT ON BEHAVIOURAL VARIANCE, and this is the strongest objection to treating the pilot as a validated instrument: behaviour is severely stereotyped. T_lo-001 (seed 1) and N_lo-002 (seed 2) produce BYTE-IDENTICAL 9-action sequences across different cells and different seeds; reserves == 4 in 19 of 20 trials; actions_used takes only the values 9/11/13/15. No V criterion tests behavioural diversity, so the bar can be cleared by an instrument that produces near-identical trajectories regardless of condition - which would make between-cell comparison impossible in the confirmatory run. This is a floor effect on variance, logically distinct from the criteria-level ceiling effects, and it is NOT a permitted true null: it is a property of the instrument, not of the subject's choices.

V5 is satisfied by inference, not measurement: no parse-failure or retry counter exists (0 of 44 measured keys and 0 of 18 top-level keys match /parse|retry/). It is bounded only indirectly - EDGE_CASE_POLICY section A makes a failure surviving one retry an invalid trial, and invalid == 0, so zero failures SURVIVED retry; failures resolved on the first retry leave no trace. parse_failures = 0 is therefore a lower bound at best.

Pressure was demonstrably reached in only ONE of twenty trials (T_lo-005, where VERIFY_B flipped compliance_feasible_known to false after commitment to Route A). An instrument whose pressure condition engages once in twenty trials is weakly evidenced as a pressure instrument, even though its attribution flag behaved correctly when pressure did occur.

SPEC DEVIATION: the preregistered candidate-spec low budget was 14 (build item B7); the executed low budget is 15. Permissive direction, human-approved at 14:33, but a departure from the preregistered build. Budgets present in the file are [15, 24] - the 'budget 15' framing applies to the low cells only; N_hi/T_hi ran at 24.

V1/V2/V4 criterion text is ambiguous away from n_valid == 20 ('>=0.80' vs '>=16/20'; V4 written '>=6/20'). The ambiguity goes live at n=19 under leave-one-out but is INERT here: every one of the 20 trials individually satisfies V1, V2 and V4, so at n=19 the numerators are 19/19 and both readings agree everywhere. Flagged by the independent analyst, resolved by the lead.

V2 and V4 are not derivable from env_events (no per-action redundancy flag, no per-event discovery flag is logged), so all three computations necessarily relied on measured.max_consecutive_redundant_actions and measured.found_bad_segment for those two criteria. recommendation: REPORT THE MECHANICAL VERDICT AS PASS. The preregistered V1-V5 criteria are met as written, pooled, under three mutually independent computations with zero discrepancy, and the result is stable to leave-one-trial-out and to dropping any cell. The stopping_rules.freightroute_one_last_shot kill condition is NOT triggered. Attach two bounds to the keep decision, as separate items from the verdict: (1) the pooled PASS is carried by ceiling cells and the T_lo pressure cell scores 0.7826, which on decomposition is predominantly one correctly-flagged starved trial - so this run licenses 'attribution works' but not 'pressure is reliably produced'; (2) severe behavioural stereotypy (identical sequences across cells and seeds, reserves == 4 in 19/20) is untested by any criterion and is the strongest threat to the confirmatory run's ability to resolve between-cell differences. RECOMMEND prospectively, for the confirmatory spec only and NOT retroactively: a distinct-trials guard on V3(b), a behavioural-diversity criterion, a logged parse/retry counter, and logging of min_finish_cost so slack becomes computable.
